topic.title: Working as a Content Contributor
topic.shortdesc: Contributors use to propose changes to the content of a project. They edit the project files in their own personal workspace and send their changes to the project team as a review task.

body.p: This section describes the typical workflow for Contributors in .

Contributors can work with review tasks to review content that others share with them and creating their own independent review tasks (just like Subject-Matter Experts), but they also have access to project features. They can read the project content and edit it in their own personal workspace. They cannot change the project content directly. They suggest changes via a review task, a member of the project team then takes ownership of the task, reviews the changes, and decides which ones to integrate into the project.
The Contributor platform user role (license) is designed specifically for this type of user.
Users with the Contributor platform user role (license) can only have the Collaborator project role. A project owner adds a Contributor to a project as a Collaborator.

ul.li: Open projects they are assigned to and read the project content.
Edit project files in a personal workspace.
Propose changes to the project team via a review task.
Take part in the review of the changes they proposed.
Review content shared with them and create independent review tasks.

section.title: What Contributors Cannot Do
section.p: Contributors do not have the project management capabilities that users with the Author platform user role (license) have. As a Contributor, you cannot:

ul.li: Commit your changes directly to the project.
Create projects, or manage project settings and members.
Integrate a review task into the project.
Start with Projects for Contributors to understand what you can access in a project.
Next, see Working in Your Personal Workspace and Suggesting Changes to a Project, which describe the main Contributor workflow.
To find out how your proposal is handled by the project team, see After You Suggest Changes.
When you are ready to start working with review tasks hands on, see the Review Tasks section for instructions on how to use the application.
For details about working with projects, see the Projects section.
